description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dutugemunu Village, Dehiwala D/S Division,  Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520802
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their owners, property details, and encumbrances. The content is specifically published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification criteria.
